items.title: “Missing Forest-for-the-Trees”: Datadog Sinks 17% in a Week as Its Biggest AI Customer Cuts Back
items.summary: Key TakeawaysDatadog stock fell 17% in a week after a roughly flat fourth-quarter revenue guide outweighed 35% third-quarter growth. The guide counts its largest customer, an AI company that cut its usage, only at its contract minimum.

items.title: Datadog (DDOG) Stock Gets Fair Value Trim After Mixed Views On Q4 And AI Demand
items.summary: Datadog’s updated fair value estimate has shifted from US$292.36 to US$271.71 per share, which marks a modest reset in how the stock is being valued today. Analysts are split, with some pointing to strong Q3 results, AI related demand and Datadog’s broad customer base, while others lean on softer Q4 guidance, early renewals and volume discounts when considering where the stock should trade. As you read on, you will see how these moving pieces shape the evolving Datadog story and what to watch...

items.title: Cloudflare CEO Sees “an Even Higher Gear” After Q3 Revenue Jumps 39%
items.summary: Key TakeawaysCloudflare’s third-quarter revenue rose 39% to $782. 5 million, its fastest growth in nearly four years and $46 million above its own guidance midpoint.

items.title: Datadog Sinks 17% in a Week Despite “Strong Adoption Across Our Platform”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysDatadog stock fell 17% in a week to $179, as a flat fourth-quarter revenue guide overshadowed 35% third-quarter growth. The guide assumes its largest AI customer pays only its contract minimum, while growth from everyone else is implied in the low to mid 30s.
